resolution.note: skill-harvest test uses fresh mkdtemp dirs; with a .claude/skills file planted at TMPDIR the old test fails ENOTDIR and the new one passes.

title: skill-harvest test reads the shared temp root
body: Evidence 2026-11-18: lane t-sy4qhg1 saw test/brain/skill-harvest.test.ts fail on main with ENOTDIR on /mnt/storage/tmp/krn/.claude/skills; the test runs krn with cwd tmpdir() (line 52) and `standards harvest --skills tmpdir()` (line 199), so its verdict depends on whatever other processes leave under the shared temp root (that root holds a .claude directory from other runs).
Outcome: the test uses only fresh mkdtemp directories it owns; the shared temp root is never a cwd or a skills source.
Proof: node --test test/brain/skill-harvest.test.ts: pass with a .claude/skills file planted at the temp root.
